notes: Vanilla canvas 2D, zero libraries. Sunset palette with a big low sun, stars, drifting clouds, and lens-flare dots. 7 parallax layers: sky (static), far ridge, near ridge, conifer treeline, roadside props (streetlights with glow, bushes, signs, rocks), road with scrolling dashes + asphalt flecks + sun reflection smear, near-foreground grass racing at 1.35x. Scenery is deterministic per tile index (seeded sin hash), so the loop is seamless but varied. Car: coupe silhouette with gradient body, sunset rim light, reflective glass, rolling 5-spoke wheels synced to road distance (true rolling, no slip), independent suspension bob/pitch, headlight beam, taillight glow, exhaust puffs, soft shadow. Cinematic letterbox bars, vignette, and animated film grain. Headless-chrome verified: no console errors, road speed measured at 249 px/s; pixel sampling confirmed sun, sky gradient, ridges, road, car body and glass all render; sun was repositioned above the far ridge after verification showed the ridge silhouette was occluding it.
